Matched needs: 多时段调度、储能充放电、系统电压改善、灵活性调度、跨时段平衡。 / Multi-period scheduling, storage charge/discharge, voltage improvement, flexibility dispatch, and inter-temporal balancing.
Strengths: AC/DC 混合建模适合同时处理配电与输电侧协调，且滚动时域与灵活性市场机制对高渗透可再生场景很实用。 / Hybrid AC/DC modeling is useful for coordinating distribution and transmission, and the rolling horizon plus flexibility market mechanism is practical for high-renewable scenarios.
Limitations: 更偏灵活性市场清算与 TSO-DSO 协调，不是专门针对可再生波动下的备用分配；且未包含无功灵活性。 / It emphasizes flexibility market clearing and TSO-DSO coordination rather than reserve allocation under renewable variability, and it does not include reactive power flexibility.
Objective text: Minimize total operating cost of transmission and distribution generation, flexibility activation, battery operation, and load shedding across all periods.
Constraint text: SOC-ACOPF power balance and conic relaxation constraints; AC-DC coupling constraint; DC power balance, line flow limits, slack angle; flexible generation/load bounds; zero-net load shifting; battery SoC, charge/discharge, and terminal SoC constraints; load shedding equals served load.
Parameter text: Generation cost coefficients, flexibility prices, battery cost, load-shedding cost, network susceptance matrices, active/reactive load limits, generation limits, line flow limits, slack angle, battery SoC bounds, charge/discharge limits, efficiencies, and initial SoC.
Mathematical problem types: SecondOrderConeProgrammingProblem | Second-Order Cone Programming Problem; LinearProgrammingProblem | Linear Programming Problem

Requirement text: In a market environment, OPF is not only used for cost minimization, but may also serve day-ahead markets, real-time markets, reserve markets, and profit maximization.
PDF file: Day-Ahead and Real Time Optimal Power Flow.pdf
Paper title: Day-Ahead and Real Time Optimal Power Flow considering Renewable Energy Resources
Recommendation reason: 最贴合用户对日前与实时市场、以及利润最大化/成本优化并存的需求。 / Best matches the user’s need for day-ahead and real-time market use, while also supporting profit maximization alongside cost optimization.
Matched needs: 明确覆盖日前与实时多时段调度，并直接给出利润最大化目标。 / Explicitly covers day-ahead and real-time multi-interval scheduling, and directly includes a profit-maximization objective.
Strengths: 同时支持日前与实时场景，目标函数包含成本最小化与利润最大化，且保留AC潮流与运行约束，适合市场化OPF建模。 / Supports both day-ahead and real-time settings, includes both cost minimization and profit maximization, and retains AC power-flow and operating constraints, making it well suited for market-oriented OPF.
Limitations: 主要聚焦含可再生能源的日前/实时调度，对备用市场的显式联合出清较弱，且采用固定参与因子，市场机制灵活性有限。 / Mainly focuses on renewable-integrated day-ahead/real-time scheduling, has weaker explicit joint clearing for reserve markets, and uses fixed participation factors, limiting market-mechanism flexibility.
Objective text: Minimize total generation cost over RT sub-intervals; maximize total profit over DA intervals as revenue minus generation cost.
Constraint text: Active and reactive nodal power balance, generator output limits with ramp-up/down limits, renewable output caps, bus-voltage limits, line-flow limits, and demand-supply balance constraint in DA-OPF.
Parameter text: Generator cost coefficients; energy price; wind and solar direct cost coefficients; bus admittance Gij/Bij; ramp limits; voltage and line-flow limits; forecasted load, wind, and solar outputs; participation factors.
Technologies: OEO_00010423 | power generation technology; OEO_00010428 | photovoltaic technology; OEO_00010424 | wind power technology

Requirement text: In a market environment, OPF is not only used for cost minimization, but may also serve day-ahead markets, real-time markets, reserve markets, and profit maximization.
Paper title: Reserve Constrained AC Optimal Power Flow Using Accelerated Primal-Dual Interior Point Method
Recommendation reason: 最适合用户提到的备用市场与利润/市场收益优化需求。 / Best suited to the user’s reserve-market and profit/market-surplus optimization needs.
Matched needs: 直接建模备用约束，并以市场盈余最大化为目标，覆盖市场环境中的备用配置与收益优化。 / Directly models reserve constraints and maximizes market surplus, covering reserve allocation and revenue-oriented optimization in a market setting.
Strengths: AC网络约束完整，包含能量与备用协同优化，适合备用市场、辅助服务和安全运行联合考虑。 / Full AC network constraints, co-optimization of energy and reserve, and a strong fit for reserve markets, ancillary services, and secure operation.
Limitations: 是单时段模型，不覆盖日前/实时多时段市场调度；目标更偏市场盈余而非显式利润最大化。 / It is a single-period model, so it does not cover day-ahead or real-time multi-period market scheduling; the objective is market surplus rather than explicit profit maximization.
Objective text: Maximize total market surplus: device consumption benefit minus generation cost, imbalance penalties, branch overload penalties, reserve offer costs, zonal reserve shortfall penalties, and reactive reserve costs.
Constraint text: Equality constraints enforce device definitions, reserve cost definitions, AC branch flow equations, bus real/reactive power balances, and zonal reserve requirements; inequalities bound device outputs, reserve capabilities, voltage magnitudes, transformer settings, branch apparent flows, shunt steps, and reserve requirements.
Parameter text: Offer/bid block prices, imbalance penalty costs, branch overload penalty cost, reserve marginal costs, branch conductance/susceptance, shunt coefficients, device power limits, reserve capability limits, zonal reserve requirements and scaling factors, branch flow limits, voltage/tap/phase bounds.

Requirement text: In a market environment, OPF is not only used for cost minimization, but may also serve day-ahead markets, real-time markets, reserve markets, and profit maximization.
Model name: Scalable Security Constrained Multi Step OPF
Paper title: Scalable Solutions for Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow With Multiple Time Steps
Recommendation reason: 适合多时段、安全约束、备用约束并重的市场化OPF，尤其适合大规模日前调度。 / Suitable for market-oriented OPF with multi-step, security, and reserve constraints, especially for large-scale day-ahead scheduling.
Matched needs: 支持多时段调度、备用与安全约束，并以市场盈余最大化为目标，能覆盖市场环境下的联合优化需求。 / Supports multi-step scheduling, reserve and security constraints, and maximizes market surplus, covering joint optimization needs in market environments.
Strengths: 可扩展性强，适合大规模系统和严格时间限制，且同时考虑安全约束、备用、爬坡和切换等运行因素。 / Highly scalable for large systems and strict time limits, while considering security constraints, reserves, ramping, and switching.
Limitations: 更强调大规模安全约束求解与市场盈余，而不是细化的日前/实时/备用市场机制；多步结构下实现复杂度较高。 / It emphasizes large-scale security-constrained solving and market surplus rather than detailed day-ahead/real-time/reserve market mechanisms; implementation complexity is high in multi-step settings.
Objective text: Maximize total market surplus z over device powers, bus voltage angles, and switching variables.
Constraint text: Equality constraints G enforce power-balance and AC/DC network equations; inequality constraints H cover voltage limits, real/reactive power limits, reserves, ramping, switching, contingency, and device operation constraints.
Parameter text: Device power pjt, bus voltage angle θit, switching status ujt, shunt conductance gshjt, branch flow limits smaxj, reserve factors σscrn, ramp-up Pru, ramp-down Prd, and mismatch penalty pit.
Mathematical problem types: MixedIntegerLinearProgrammingProblem | Mixed-Integer Linear Programming Problem; NonlinearProgrammingProblem | Nonlinear Programming Problem

Requirement text: When distributed grids, user-side DERs, and loads participate in scheduling, nodes or users may be unwilling to share complete electricity consumption data.
Paper title: Chance-Constrained OPF: A Distributed Method With Confidentiality Preservation
Recommendation reason: 最贴合用户核心需求：分布式调度中，区域/用户不愿共享完整用电数据时仍可协同求解。/ Best matches the core need: coordinated scheduling when regions/users do not want to share full consumption data in distributed dispatch.
Matched needs: 明确支持分布式多区域调度、保密/隐私保护、以及在不公开完整负荷与拓扑细节下求解 OPF。/ Explicitly supports distributed multi-region scheduling, confidentiality/privacy preservation, and solving OPF without exposing full load and topology details.
Strengths: 隐私保护是核心设计目标；分布式求解；还能处理多时段与不确定性；并保持较高最优性。/ Privacy preservation is a core design goal; distributed solving; also handles multi-period operation and uncertainty; preserves high optimality.
Limitations: 基于线性化潮流与机会约束形式，若需要完整 AC 非线性精度或更细致配网物理细节，适用边界会收窄。/ Based on linearized power flow and chance-constrained formulation; if full AC nonlinear accuracy or finer distribution-grid physics is required, applicability narrows.
Objective text: Minimize total generation cost: sum over regions and time of quadratic and linear dispatchable-generation costs.
Constraint text: Capacity bounds, ramp-rate limits, supply-demand chance constraint, and chance constraints on voltages or line flows converted to deterministic inequalities.
Parameter text: Generation cost coefficients, generator capacity bounds, ramp-rate bounds, wind-power quantiles from GMMs, chance limits εb and αS, and DLPF mapping coefficients.
Technologies: OEO_00010423 | power generation technology; OEO_00010424 | wind power technology

Model name: Demand Response AC OPF Flexible Loads

Recommendation reason: 适合用户侧 DER、灵活负荷和需求响应参与调度的场景，且直接建模 AC OPF。/ Suitable for scenarios where user-side DERs, flexible loads, and demand response participate in scheduling, with direct AC OPF modeling.
Matched needs: 覆盖用户侧负荷、EV/HVAC 聚合器、储能与可再生不确定性，能协调分布式电网中的参与式调度。/ Covers user-side loads, EV/HVAC aggregators, storage, and renewable uncertainty, enabling participatory scheduling in distributed grids.

Requirement name: Computational Speed / Online Tractability and Accuracy and Physical Feasibility
Requirement text: Real-world OPF needs to be completed within the time scale of market clearing, real-time dispatch, or voltage control. Approximate models and ML predictions are fast, but they may violate AC power flow and security constraints. Therefore, physical feasibility must be guaranteed.
Model name: Real Time Sequential Security Constrained OPF
Paper title: Real-Time Sequential Security-Constrained Optimal Power Flow: A Hybrid Knowledge-Data-Driven Reinforcement Learning Approach
Recommendation reason: 最符合“在市场清算、实时调度或电压控制时间尺度内完成，并且必须保证物理可行性”的核心要求。/ Best matches the core requirement of finishing within market-clearing, real-time dispatch, or voltage-control timescales while guaranteeing physical feasibility.
Matched needs: 实时/准实时求解、AC 安全约束、发电有功/无功联合调度、电压与支路潮流限值、面向不准确环境参数的鲁棒运行。/ Real-time or near-real-time solving, AC security constraints, joint active/reactive dispatch, voltage and branch-flow limits, and robust operation under inaccurate environmental parameters.
Strengths: 直接面向实时安全约束 OPF，输出安全的有功/无功调度并保持电压与支路潮流在限值内。/ Directly targets real-time security-constrained OPF, producing safe active/reactive dispatch while keeping voltages and branch flows within limits. 采用强化学习加安全层投影，推理速度快，适合在线决策。/ Uses reinforcement learning with a safety-layer projection, enabling fast inference suitable for online decisions. 对大系统与多时段序列调度有较强适配性。/ Strong adaptability to large systems and sequential multi-step dispatch.
Limitations: 物理可行性依赖线性化安全层与保守裕度，极端工况下可能需要更紧的约束。/ Physical feasibility depends on a linearized safety layer and conservative margins, so extreme operating conditions may require tighter constraints. 作为学习型方法，部署时需要与目标系统分布保持一致。/ As a learning-based method, deployment works best when the operating distribution matches the trained regime.
Objective text: Minimize cumulative generation operating cost, with quadratic cost coefficients for each generator over time.
Constraint text: AC power-balance equations, branch active/reactive flow equations, generator active/reactive limits, branch flow limits, voltage magnitude limits, and ramping-coupled generator bounds; safety-layer projection also enforces linearized security constraints and power balance.
Parameter text: Generator cost coefficients; generator active/reactive bounds and ramping limits; bus voltages; line conductance/susceptance or resistance/reactance; branch flow limits; load demand and forecasted load; slack-bus limits; penalty coefficients; SAC temperature and learning rates.

Matched needs: 在线/实时安全约束 OPF、AC 可行性、支路与电压约束、故障后安全运行。/ Online or real-time security-constrained OPF, AC feasibility, branch and voltage limits, and post-contingency secure operation.
Strengths: 推理阶段可快速输出可行调度，适合在线应用。/ Can output feasible dispatch quickly at inference time, suitable for online use. 采用模型辅助 DRL 与 KKT 梯度，兼顾速度与约束意识。/ Uses model-assisted DRL with KKT-based gradients, balancing speed and constraint awareness. 对较大系统也有较好扩展性。/ Shows good scalability to larger systems.
Limitations: 属于静态单时刻 preventive SCOPF，不覆盖多时段市场清算耦合。/ It is a static single-snapshot preventive SCOPF and does not cover multi-period market-clearing coupling. 在部分故障场景下无功约束仍可能出现偏差。/ Reactive-power constraints may still deviate in some contingency cases.
Objective text: Minimize total generation cost, defined as the sum of quadratic generator cost functions over the base case
Constraint text: Equality constraints enforce AC power balance for base case and contingencies; inequality constraints enforce generator capacity, bus-voltage bounds, and transmission-line flow limits

Recommendation reason: 满足实时 OPF 的速度要求，并明确考虑运行约束，适合需要快速闭环调度的场景。/ Meets the speed requirement for real-time OPF and explicitly considers operating constraints, making it suitable for fast closed-loop dispatch.
Matched needs: 实时调度、AC 约束、发电与电压设定在线输出、快速响应波动。/ Real-time dispatch, AC constraints, online generator and voltage setpoints, and fast response to fluctuations.
Strengths: 在线推理快，时间节省显著。/ Very fast online inference with substantial time savings. 直接输出发电与电压设定，便于调度执行。/ Directly outputs generator and voltage setpoints, which are easy to execute. 采用拉格朗日约束处理，兼顾经济性与可行性。/ Uses Lagrangian constraint handling to balance economics and feasibility.

Matched needs: 明确包含机组启停状态、联合 UC-OPF、多时段调度与 AC 潮流约束 / Explicitly includes generator on/off status, coordinated UC-OPF, multi-period scheduling, and AC power-flow constraints.
Strengths: 直接输出最优机组启停状态与出力，且适用于微电网场景；同时考虑随机风电、PEV、储能和电压稳定性，覆盖“开停机+运行可行性”两类关键问题 / Directly outputs optimal generator on/off status and dispatch, and is tailored to microgrid settings; it also covers stochastic wind, PEVs, storage, and voltage stability, addressing both commitment and operational feasibility.

Constraint text: Active/reactive power balance; generator output limits; ramp-up/down limits; minimum up/down times; start-up/shut-down logic; spinning reserve; branch flow and voltage limits; L-index voltage-stability limit; wind/PV output relations; ESS SOC and charge/discharge limits; PEV energy, charging/discharging, and parking-lot capacity limits.
Parameter text: Generator cost coefficients ag, bg, cg, Csupg, Csdng; reserve requirement RESt; voltage limits Vmin/Vmax; branch limits Smaxij; L-index limit Llimt; wind scenario probabilities πs and mean wind speeds vs; PEV capacities and efficiencies; ESS capacities and efficiencies; ramp rates Rupg/Rdng; minimum up/down times Tupg/Tdng.
Technologies: OEO_00010423 | power generation technology; OEO_00010428 | photovoltaic technology; OEO_00010424 | wind power technology
